visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Stops at Any Match
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The first 2 is at index 1, but the program prints 2, the index of the middle 2.

solution.explanation: A plain binary search returns as soon as it hits the target, which may be any of the equal values. To find the first one, record the hit and keep searching the left half for an earlier one.
